title: Carrots and Sticks
coreMove: When a spike comes from Price, Promotion, Fear, Aspiration, Peer pressure, or Novelty, treat it as borrowed until people act again without that push.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who confuse a lift with loyalty
exampleSpecs.stakes: a price cut gets mistaken for preference
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open at the return moment and catch the miss late

exampleSpecs.stakes: a short-term response is misread as belief
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: start after the offer and leave the return point unmet

exampleSpecs.audience: readers sorting social pull from belief
exampleSpecs.stakes: a useful nudge is mistaken for a deeper reason
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open when someone downstream feels the effect

exampleSpecs.stakes: attention is counted as a buying reason
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open on the early signal and let the miss land

exampleSpecs.stakes: a perk becomes a fake reason
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open at the demand and leave the return point open
